definitions.explanation: A defensive player in baseball who covers the outfield area. Includes left fielder, center fielder, and right fielder.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{外野手|がいやしゅ}として{活躍|かつやく}している。
examples.english: He is active as an outfielder.

examples.japanese: {外野手|がいやしゅ}がフライを{見事|みごと}にキャッチした。
examples.english: The outfielder made a brilliant catch of the fly ball.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}のドラフトで{指名|しめい}された{外野手|がいやしゅ}は{足|あし}が{速|はや}くて{肩|かた}も{強|つよ}い。
examples.english: The outfielder drafted this year is fast and has a strong arm.

notes:
Compound of {外野|がいや} (outfield) + {手|しゅ} (player, performer). A standard baseball term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {左翼|さよく}{外野手|がいやしゅ}: left fielder (レフト)
- {中堅|ちゅうけん}{外野手|がいやしゅ}: center fielder (センター)
- {右翼|うよく}{外野手|がいやしゅ}: right fielder (ライト)
- {外野手|がいやしゅ}の{守備|しゅび}: outfield defense

RELATED TERMS:
- {内野手|ないやしゅ}: infielder
- {投手|とうしゅ}: pitcher
- {捕手|ほしゅ}: catcher
- {外野|がいや}: outfield; also used figuratively to mean "bystander" or "outsider"
